item.title: Flannery O’Connor Institute continues Southern Gothic Lecture Series with lecture by Kendra Hamilton, showing of ‘Sinners’
item.description: The Flannery O’Connor Institute for the Humanities, sponsored by Georgia Humanities, will hold the second annual lecture in the Southern Gothic Lecture Series this week.

item.title: GRIFFIN: Boots on the Ground at the Capitol
item.description: My colleagues and I returned to the Georgia State Capitol on Monday, Feb. 9, to kick off the fifth week of the 2026 legislative session.

item.title: GMC Prep’s Joyce Chow is Baldwin Co. STAR Student
item.description: Georgia Military College Prep Class of 2026 salutatorian Joyce Chow will represent Baldwin County at the regional STAR Student recognition next month.

item.title: SEAGRAVES: Remembered
item.description: In January 2020, as the world was preparing to shut down, a group of 8th grade cadets from Georgia Military College gathered at Shiloh Baptist Church in Harrisburg to give honor and tribute to three young men who perished during World War I.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Take precautions with outdoor burning
item.description: Our community has experienced a significant number of structure fires and brush fires.

item.title: Community open house March 4 for new EV labs at CGTC campus
item.description: Central Georgia Technical College (CGTC) will open its doors to the community on Wednesday, March 4, with a drop-in open house from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., celebrating the completion of its new, state-of-the-art lab spaces for Electric Vehicle (EV) Automotive and Mechatronics on the Milledgeville campus.

item.title: Little wants tax assessors board members ousted
item.description: The latest meeting of the Baldwin County Board of Commissioners was disheartening, says District 5 Commissioner Scott Little.

item.title: Strickland talks about Dept. of Revenue probe
item.description: Baldwin County Commissioner Andrew Strickland recently took to social media to express his views concerning findings in the performance state review for the local board of tax assessors.

item.title: Hotel, restaurant projects on the horizon
item.description: The skyline of Milledgeville could change drastically in the future with the possibility of at least four new hotels altering the landscape.

item.title: Authorities rule house fire accidental
item.description: A fire that destroyed a residence on the 100 block of Garrett Way in Baldwin County earlier this week has been ruled accidental, a local fire official says.
